# Uyir

> Uyir is an alternative education platform in Palakkad, Kerala, fostering self-directed learning, STEM education, and creative expression for homeschoolers and open learners.

Uyir provides a community-driven learning environment combining STEM education with philosophy-based pedagogy. The platform empowers learners through self-directed projects, collaborative storytelling, and creative writing while supporting alternative education models like homeschooling and NIOS/IGCSE pathways.

## Key Topics

- Alternative Education
- STEM Education
- Self-Directed Learning
- Homeschooling
- Creative Writing
- Child Development
- Natural Learning

- IGCSE

## Core Platform & Philosophy

- [Alternative education in Palakkad | Uyir](https://www.uyir.at): Uyir's homepage for alternative learning in Palakkad with STEM education.
- [On Education | Uyir](https://www.uyir.at/oneducation): Uyir's educational philosophy center for homeschoolers and open learners.
- [STEM Education in Palakkad | Uyir](https://www.uyir.at/stemeducation): Uyir's STEM education program emphasizing innovation and problem-solving.

## Community & Organization

- [About Us | Uyir](https://www.uyir.at/team): Uyir team members including founder Vinod Krishnan and mission statement.
- [Dashboard - Children](https://www.uyir.at/dashboard): Learning status dashboard for Uyir children tracking progress and posts.

## Student Creations & Stories

- [Mark Knights: The result of exploration .Volume 1](https://www.uyir.at/post/mark-knights-the-result-of-exploration-volume-1): Student-created detective mystery fiction serialized story by learners.
- [Pass the paragraph challenage pt-1](https://www.uyir.at/post/pass-the-paragraph-challenage-pt-1): Collaborative sci-fi fiction challenge by students Sreeshan, Eshaaan, Ayana.
- [HOW TO ANALAYSE A PERSON, TO IF HE IS GOOD OR BAD. [MY EXPIRENCE]](https://www.uyir.at/post/how-to-analayse-a-person-to-if-he-is-good-or-bad-my-expirence): Student blog post on character analysis and behavioral pattern assessment.
